name: Key Lime
siboNotes: Key limes are well-tolerated on SIBO diets as citrus fruits are naturally low in fermentable carbohydrates and provide beneficial vitamin C.
preparationTips: Roll lime on counter before juicing to release more juice
Use zest sparingly as it's more concentrated in flavor
Fresh juice is best - avoid bottled versions with additives
Store at room temperature for softer texture and easier juicing
